title: Regen authenticated_schc_dio.json DODAGIDs to upstream AddrForKey + flip line-361 binding oracle
description: Discovered-from 1p2r.4. test/vectors/authenticated_schc_dio.json DIO DODAGIDs still encode the rejected native SHA-512 profile; python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:361 (test_authenticated_schc_dio_construction_has_independent_security_checks) checks root binding dio[8:24] == _addr_for_key(public_key) against it (stale-but-green per 1p2r comment: validates the rejected profile). Fix: regen corpus DODAGIDs to upstream AddrForKey (oracle: pinned yggdrasil_address.json anchor / independent reimplementation), flip the binding check to _upstream_addr_for_key, then delete the legacy native _addr_for_key helper if no consumers remain (root_authorization.json flip is the other last consumer — coordinate with its bead).
